outcome.technical: F656 reproduces, but as an obscure failure rather than a pass: with a broken python3 resolved by py-launch.sh the gate failed 21 of 41 checks each blaming its own hook/journal detail, none naming the interpreter (it never passed). Added interpreter_problem(env, cwd) to tools/check-git-pipeline.py: probes python3, python, py (the launcher's names, read from the same order) on the fixture env PATH with a probe that must print; returns None if any one runs (launcher falls through broken candidates), else a sentence naming each candidate with its path, exit code and output. build_fixture calls it right after the git/sh presence checks and before any repository work, returning a problem, so the run prints 'git pipeline: NOT CHECKED - no Python interpreter that py-launch.sh could pick will run - ...' and exits 1. Selftest cases k13-k17 added (17/17 pass, was 12): k13 is the description case (all three shims exit 1 -> unusable), k14 exit-0-silent shim unusable, k15 allow (broken python3 first, working python later -> no problem), k16 name list equals the launcher's `for py in` line, k17 build_fixture end to end under a broken PATH (no .git made, render NOT CHECKED, exit 1). Real runs: broken PATH exit 1 with the NOT CHECKED line; normal PATH exit 0 'OK'. sweep-selftests on the file: ok 17 cases; ruff and vermin clean; prose_number_claims() reports 0 violations. Shims for nt are .cmd files and untested on Windows. Plan gate allowed every edit. Worktree HEAD printed before first edit: 5ba3b0fe.
